fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) rose 272.9% over one year (vs. S&P 500 +11.5%), with AI-driven revenue surge reaching $54.2B in fiscal 2026 Q4 (vs. $11.3B prior year).
fields.summary_ko.1: Net income grew faster than revenue, reaching 80.7% operating margin, though stock fell 22.4% from end-September through November, raising valuation concerns.
fields.summary_ko.2: Trailing P/E of 11.1x is cheaper than S&P 500's 22.8x, but historical earnings volatility and cyclical industry nature question sustainability.
